# Indian Airports

All airports and airstrips with IATA code, city, state, and coordinates

- API: https://chirag127.github.io/india-airports/data.json
- OpenAPI: https://chirag127.github.io/india-airports/openapi.json
- Schema: https://chirag127.github.io/india-airports/data/schema.json
- License: CC-BY-4.0
- Source: AAI open data
- Status: india-airports
